note: Meepo electric longboard (D-057). ride_speed m/s (walk 4.5, sprint 7.0); ride_accel = how fast you reach it (board feel); battery 0-100 drains battery_drain_per_s while rolling faster than 1 m/s, recharges recharge_per_s within charger_range_m of a Meepo dock (group meepo_chargers).
